- Where seen: the `pull_request` run of `test-nightly-tiers.yml` on PR #27122 (run 40647023027, head `5fe8c76d9a` = `origin/main` `07d18e69` + a retired-patrol-name rename touching no `ui/**`, `packages/console/**` or `examples/**` file). Shard 2/2 failed with exactly this card's `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta.e2e.test.ts` (same six tests, same assertions). Shard 1/2 ALSO failed (job 122678103682, completed 2026-10-28T07:33Z):
  - `examples/app-showcase/test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` → Playwright `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` 「ungrouped + related-heavy: flat details and related-list tabs on Contoso」: `getByRole('tab', { name: /Details/i })` not found (L164, 5 s timeout, retried once); 52/53 smoke tests passed; screenshot artifact `showcase-smoke-diagnostics-1`, file `test-results/detail-shapes-ungrouped-re-49c76-elated-list-tabs-on-Contoso-chromium/test-failed-1.png`.
- Why this card does not list it: on main's own run 40638682260 (2026-10-28T05:33Z, `76e90df6`) shard 2/2 failed first and the matrix fail-fast `cancelled` shard 1/2, so the report job saw only the cli file. While the cli failure stands, every nightly will cancel shard 1 the same way; once PR #27132 (this card's fix) lands, the next scheduled nightly (cron `29 5 * * *` UTC, the `next by` deadline in the `Swept` line above) is the first that can show the showcase red on main — this note is 22 hours earlier.
- Narrowing for the ui lane: the last green nightly on main was run 40456620499 on `b53322d5` (2026-10-27T05:40Z). Commits in `b53322d5..07d18e69` touching `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/**`: `17b5152d` (#26804, record opens one way per object; `modal`/`split`/`popover` retired), `7414fc8e` (#27031, Display menu's Open records section), `3230bdbf`, `6aba7cbc`, `fbc16563`, `27133776`, `69df290e`, `c8097a90`, `76e90df6`, `19a2b617`, `dc87dfb5`, `6e5f909a`. `34c2407b` (#27038, record drawer in place) landed after `07d18e69` and is not in the reading. The spec comments cite ADR-0085's prominence rule (related lists surface as tabs); `RecordDetailView.accessibleNames-12625.test.tsx` L173 still pins a `Details` tab at unit level, so the gap is between the unit fixture and the served showcase page (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts` L404 and `pages/*-detail.page.ts` declare `Details` sections; the Contoso account page is heuristic).
- Main-red convention ②: one failing check anchors one card, so this reading lands here rather than on a new card. Whether it splits into a `domain:ui` card is triage's / the devx seat's call; the seat that owns #27114 may want its PR #27132's landing comment to say the check will still be red on the next nightly for this second file.
